CVE.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookups reach attacker controlled LDAP endpoints
CVE.description: Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP endpoints. An attacker who controls log messages can execute arbitrary code.
CVE.affected: [{'vendor': 'Apache Software Foundation', 'product': 'Apache Log4j2', 'versions': ['2.0-beta9 to <2.3.1', '2.4 to <2.12.2', '2.13.0 to <2.15.0']}]
CVE.remediation: Upgrade to Log4j 2.17.1 or later; remove the JndiLookup class as an interim mitigation.

CVE.title: OpenSSH: Terrapin
CVE.description: The SSH transport protocol with certain OpenSSH extensions, found in OpenSSH before 9.6 and other products, allows remote attackers to bypass integrity checks such that some packets are omitted, aka a Terrapin attack.
CVE.remediation: Review vendor advisory and apply available patches: https://example.test/security-advisory/2023-48795

CVE.title: OpenSSH: Race Condition
CVE.description: A signal handler race condition was found in OpenSSH's server (sshd), where a client does not authenticate within LoginGraceTime seconds. This issue is fixed in version 9.8p1.

CVE.title: OpenSSL: Obtain sensitive information from process memory via crafted packets that trigger a buffer over-read
CVE.description: The TLS and DTLS implementations in OpenSSL 1.0.1 before 1.0.1g do not properly handle Heartbeat Extension packets, which allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via crafted packets that trigger a buffer over-read.
CVE.remediation: Apply the latest security patches from the vendor.

CVE.title: Intel(R) Processors: Information Disclosure
CVE.description: Non-transparent sharing of branch predictor selectors between contexts in some Intel(R) Processors may allow an authorized user to potentially enable information disclosure via local access.
CVE.remediation: Apply the latest security patches from the vendor.

CVE.title: nginx: synthetic heap overflow in HTTP/3 module
CVE.description: A synthetic heap overflow in the nginx HTTP/3 module allows remote attackers to crash worker processes. Users are recommended to upgrade to 1.29.9, which fixes the issue.

CVE.title: Apache HTTP Server: Mapping urls to files outside the expected document root
CVE.description: A flaw was found in a change made to path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 that allows mapping URLs to files outside the expected document root.
CVE.remediation: Apply the latest security patches from the vendor.
